title: A Dark Forest
reviewNotes: All 75 boards/captions re-reviewed, including native70–75. Complete eight-piece later root after Kxa6 at 166 seconds retains White Kh3/a4/b3/c5 and Black Ka6/b4/c6/f3. Kg3 proof covers all four replies Ka5/Ka7/Kb7/f2, then exact seven-piece captures. Captures after the source Kg3/Ka5 and the f2 alternative are explicitly independent continuations of the narrated plan. Separate six-piece native175-second pawn ending has an independent Ka7/Ka5/Kb7/b4 practice line. Earlier ten-piece king-path/bishop-sacrifice/stalemate choices remain outside scope.
